messages:
Mira (AM): FYI — FinBank pre-sales: they want an EU-only POC. Key asks: region pinning, sub-processor list, network egress mapping, and a delta on pricing for reserved capacity vs hosted. Can SE/Infra/Legal weigh in? :wave:

Alex (SE): thanks Mira. quick qs — which model family are they planning to use? generator/embedding? rough QPS or tokens/mo? that drives whether dedicated is needed.

Mira (AM): they said text generation for document summarization and embeddings for search. Expect ~50k qpm peaks during runs; sustained ~200k tokens/day initially. Latency SLO: p95 < 500ms.

Jon (Infra): 500ms p95 on gen + 50k qpm is non-trivial on hosted. Options:
• Hosted API w/ regional routing: we can scope to EU regions and prefer eu-west-1/2 but we can’t guarantee physical-only processing unless we use Dedicated or Private (VPC).
• Dedicated (reserved capacity): you can pin tenant to GPU pool in eu-west, full data residency, lower jitter. Pricing delta = ~+30-60% depending on commit term and GPU class.

Alex (SE): +1. for embeddings alone hosted is fine. For gen at that scale we should propose Dedicated with autoscale burst to handle peaks. Also need KV cache sizing & batching config — those affect latency.

Li (Ops): Networking notes — customers usually want:
1) egress IP allowlist (we can provide a fixed NAT range for Dedicated),
2) peering / private link (we support VPC peering for Private),
3) subproc mapping: which CSP regions and any third-party infra (log aggregation, monitoring).

Priya (Legal): On subprocessors: we can provide our EU subprocessor inventory (data centers, logging providers, monitoring). FinBank will ask for SOC/ISO certs and a subproc attestation. Timeline: legal DD + attestation takes 7–14 business days once they submit an RFI. Also: if they insist on BYOK/KMS in their tenant we need to check compatibility with hosted — BYOK is only available on Private or Dedicated with KMS integration.

Mira (AM): they did mention BYOK as a nice-to-have. Can you draft the short bullets I can send the customer?

Alex (SE): Drafted bullets (quick):
- We offer Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments.
- Hosted: fast onboarding, regional routing, shared infra; EU-routing reduces cross-border egress but cannot guarantee isolated hardware.
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pools in EU, tenant pinning, fixed egress IPs, optional KMS integration (BYOK).
- Private: full control plane in your VPC / on-prem, required for strictest residency.
- Typical pricing: hosted = baseline; dedicated = baseline + 30–60% depending on commit & instance type; private = custom enterprise licensing.

Jon (Infra): For routing policy example we can show this snippet to illustrate how tenant pinning works:
```yaml
routing_policy:
  prefer_region: eu-west-1
  failover: eu-central-1
  allow_global_fallback: false
```

Li (Ops): Also note: for egress traceability we can provide per-request region headers and token-level cost/latency breakdown in Console for the POC.

Priya (Legal): Action items from Legal side:
- Send subproc inventory + certs (SOC2/ISO) — I can attach template.
- Confirm BYOK requirement (yes/no).
- NDA/RFI items — customer will push some changes, timeline noted above.

ops-bot: uploaded file "eu-subprocessor-inventory-2026-03.pdf" to thread.

Mira (AM): Perfect. Two asks for SE/Infra to confirm before I reply to FinBank: 1) Can we guarantee no global fallback if they pick Dedicated? 2) Rough delta estimate for 3-month POC (dedicated, single region, with BYOK + fixed egress IPs).

Alex (SE): 1) Yes — if we provision Dedicated capacity and set allow_global_fallback: false, requests will not leave pinned region unless we trigger a manual failover. 2) 3-month POC estimate ballpark: dedicated infra + reserved buffer for peaks ~ $85k–$120k (includes GPU reservations, support). If they drop BYOK or reduce commit it could be ~$60k. I'll run exact numbers with infra tiers.

Jon (Infra): I'll produce a region-specific SKU + egress IP range and confirm whether any monitoring agents touch non-EU services. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

Mira (AM): great — I’ll hold off replying until we have the SKU + legal checklist. Can we do a quick sync call tomorrow 10:30am CET?

Alex (SE): I’m in.

Li (Ops): I can make that.

Priya (Legal): I can join first 15m for subproc Qs.

Mira (AM): Awesome, inviting FinBank to that slot after we finalize numbers. Thanks team :thumbsup:
